flow.step: ICU stays with valid admission and discharge times
First postoperative stay of the hospitalization
Discharged alive from the ICU (ICU deaths excluded)
ICU discharge within the hospital (ward follow-up)
No OR / PACU / IR / ICU entry within 6 h of the ICU exit
Known limitation of life-sustaining treatment before the cutoff excluded
